title: Restore a Faded Family Scan
tests: Restores and enlarges the supplied scan while preserving identity, historical appearance, and composition.

faults.what: Some facial details look reconstructed rather than simply cleaned, especially the more pronounced smiles and teeth; skin and clothing also have a slightly over-smoothed appearance.

judge.summary: The restoration substantially improves clarity and preserves the sepia family portrait, though some facial detail looks slightly over-processed.

must_haves.item: The result depicts the same family and setting as old-photo.jpg, not a replacement family photo.
must_haves.why: The same four people, poses, house, garden, and walkway are retained.

must_haves.item: Visible scan noise is reduced and faded forms have clearer, natural contrast.
must_haves.why: The scan's mottling and colour noise are substantially reduced, with clearer clothing, faces, and architectural details.

must_haves.item: The photograph retains its sepia appearance without colourisation.
must_haves.why: The output retains a consistent warm sepia tone without introducing distinct object colours.

must_haves.item: Faces, expressions, clothing, and framing remain faithful to the source.
must_haves.why: The people remain recognisable, with matching poses, clothing, and framing, although sharpened smiles and facial details introduce some minor interpretive changes.

must_haves.item: The delivered image has a 640-pixel long edge and preserves the source aspect ratio.
must_haves.why: The square source aspect ratio is preserved, but the displayed image does not reliably establish the delivered file's native pixel dimensions.
